meta.title: Andrés Franco — Leadership, digital transformation and impact
meta.description: International executive and leader in digital transformation, artificial intelligence and intelligent automation. Vice President & Head of Latin America at SS&C Blue Prism, leadership coach, speaker and co-founder of Sereniti Foundation.
meta.ogAlt: Andrés Franco — Leadership that transforms organizations, people and communities

hero.role: Vice President & Head of Latin America · SS&C Blue Prism
hero.name: Andrés Franco
hero.statement: Leadership that transforms organizations, people and communities.
hero.support: International executive, digital transformation leader, coach and speaker with more than three decades building businesses, developing leaders and creating impact across Latin America.

intro.headline: More than 30 years building transformation.
intro.body1: An international career built at the intersection of technology, business strategy and human development. From expanding regional operations to developing leaders, the through line has never changed: organizations transform when the people behind them do.
intro.body2: That work now runs along four tracks — the digital transformation of large enterprises, the development of leaders, the public conversation about technology and society, and social impact across Latin America — all expressions of one idea of leadership.

coaching.label: Years as a certified leadership coach

transformation.headline: Digital Transformation
transformation.lead: As Vice President and Head of Latin America at SS&C Blue Prism, Andrés leads the regional strategy for intelligent automation, artificial intelligence and agentic AI, guiding large organizations through the transformation of their operations.
transformation.body: His work connects the technology agenda to the business agenda: identifying where automation creates real value, building the teams that deliver it, and making the change hold inside each organization's culture.
transformation.statement: Technology transforms processes. Leadership transforms organizations.

leadership.headline: Developing leaders who develop organizations.
leadership.lead: With more than fifteen years as a certified coach in John Maxwell leadership methodologies, Andrés works with executives and teams on development programmes that combine strategic rigour with personal growth.
leadership.body: The vantage point is that of a sitting executive, not an outside observer: the frameworks he applies while running regional operations are the same ones he brings to directors, commercial teams and organizations in transformation.

leadershipDevelopment.title: Leadership Development
leadershipDevelopment.body: Structured programmes that build leaders capable of sustaining their organizations' growth.

executiveCoaching.title: Executive Coaching
executiveCoaching.body: One-to-one work with senior leaders on high-stakes decisions and role transitions.

teamDevelopment.title: Team Development
teamDevelopment.body: Building aligned teams with clear standards of performance and trust.

organizationalTransformation.title: Organizational Transformation
organizationalTransformation.body: Cultural and operational change designed to outlast the project that started it.

strategicThinking.title: Strategic Thinking
strategicThinking.body: Decision frameworks for reading the market, setting priorities and allocating resources with judgement.

personalGrowth.title: Personal Growth
personalGrowth.body: The inner work that sustains the capacity to lead others consistently.

speaker.headline: Ideas that move people and organizations.
speaker.lead: Andrés speaks and sits on panels at executive gatherings, industry forums and corporate programmes across Latin America, in front of audiences that range from technical teams to boards of directors.
speaker.body: His talks turn complex subjects — artificial intelligence, automation, economics, leadership — into concrete decisions for the people who have to make them.

impact.headline: Leadership with purpose.
impact.lead: Andrés is co-founder of Sereniti Foundation, a US-based nonprofit dedicated to strengthening the development of Latin American communities.
impact.body: The foundation connects donors with local organizations and concentrates its work on youth education, strategic partnerships and wellness programmes, with transparency and sustainability as the standard for every project. It is the natural continuation of a commitment to community service sustained throughout his career.

recognition.title: Certificate of Special Congressional Recognition
recognition.body: Awarded to Andrés Franco and Jennifer Heegaard in recognition of their contribution to the Hispanic community and to initiatives in social impact, education and community development.

pulso.body: A space for analysis and conversation produced by Andrés Franco, where public debate is approached with the same discipline used to analyse an organization: data, context and consequences.
